requirements.quote:
Servers MUST NOT send a post-handshake CertificateRequest to clients
   which do not offer this extension.
requirements.condition: a client did not offer post_handshake_auth
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send the client a post-handshake CertificateRequest
requirements.why_checkable: The client's extension offer and subsequent server messages can be observed in one connection.

requirements.quote:
Servers MUST NOT send this
   extension.
requirements.condition: a server constructs a TLS extension block
requirements.why_checkable: Server extension blocks can be inspected for the prohibited extension.

requirements.quote:
The "extension_data" field of the "post_handshake_auth" extension is
   zero length.
requirements.condition: a client encodes or an endpoint parses post_handshake_auth
requirements.why_checkable: The extension length field and payload are directly observable.
